title: LIDS DO NOT FIT ON ANY!
text: LIDS DO NOT FIT ON ANY!. LIDS DO NOT FIT OR LOCK ON ANY OF THE CONTAINERS.  Poorly designed.  Very disappointed.  I opened and put my baking flour in the large one - no fitting or locking.  Flour also lost.

product_metadata.title: FineDine 12-Piece Airtight Food Storage Set for Kitchen - Flour, Sugar, Cereal (White)
features: KEEP YOUR PANTRY ORGANIZED: This 12-piece set of airtight food storage containers is perfect for keeping your kitchen pantry neat and tidy.
VERSATILE SIZES: The set includes 6 clear containers with lids, including two 1-gallon containers for flour, sugar, or rice, and four 76-oz containers for snacks, cereals, or oats.
DURABLE AND FRESH: Made of polypropylene, these containers are durable and long-lasting. They're also antiodor, so they will stay fresh even after years of use.
SUPERIOR AIRTIGHT LIDS: The snap-down handles on the lids create an airtight seal, keeping your food fresh and effectively leakproofing the containers.
SAFE FOR FREEZER, MICROWAVE, AND DISHWASHER: These containers can tolerate extreme temperatures, so you can safely freeze leftovers, microwave them, and then put them through the dishwasher.
